findings.evidenceJa: あれだけ消えそうだった意識
findings.governingReading: The consciousness that had seemed so close to going out is now terribly clear.
findings.explanation: The English replaces near-extinction of consciousness with fragmentation of the broader mind.

findings.highlight: Saber’s staring at me with cold eyes.
findings.evidenceJa: 目前の俺を見つめている
findings.governingReading: Saber stares at the “I” directly before her while the ruby superimposes “death” over Shirou’s first-person self.
findings.explanation: The English omits the death/I written-reading collision at the execution gate and the direct spatial proximity.
